title: Text: DET Nick Castellanos ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Have you guys been told to go home? All these reports about it with other teams and stuff
This sucks. Yesterday was my first day in Lakeland after this winter’s bs at work. Be well and congrats on the deal.
